# Synthetic fixtures

SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - made-up values in the real source's shape; not real data.

Generated by `scripts/make_synthetic_fixtures.py` (seed 20261009). They mirror the real formats of Google Trends RSS, the Google political-ads
transparency bundle, Netflix Top 10 xlsx files, YouTube channel RSS feeds and YouTube Data API v3
responses, because those sources' terms do not permit redistributing samples. Real data is
downloaded at runtime; see DATA_LICENSE.md. `tests/fixtures/osm/` holds real OSM data (ODbL).
